articles.title: Hunter Biden debuts 'LAPTOP' memecoin targeting TRUMP holders
articles.snippet: LAPTOP debuts Wednesday on Base, with nearly a third of the supply set to be burned if a slate of political and market outcomes — including a Democratic win in 2028 — comes good.

articles.title: Joe Biden’s son to launch memecoin, will send to TRUMP holders: WSJ
articles.snippet: Hunter Biden will reportedly distribute 200 million of the LAPTOP token to his substack subscribers, members of a mailing list and investors in President Donald Trump’s memecoin.

articles.title: Morning Minute: The Trenches Just Had Their Biggest Week Since TRUMP
articles.snippet: Is it a warning sign for a local top? Or is the onchain party just getting started?

articles.title: What Is LAPTOP? Hunter Biden's Meme Coin Targeting TRUMP Holders
articles.snippet: The LAPTOP token launches in September on Base, with a fifth of the supply earmarked for traders who lost money on TRUMP.

articles.title: Hunter Biden to Airdrop LAPTOP Meme Coin to TRUMP’s Biggest Losers
articles.snippet: Hunter Biden is launching a meme coin called LAPTOP on Sept. 9 on Base, and airdropping traders who lost money on TRUMP.
